subject: IOY / IONITY

decision.reason: IONITY first-party pricing effective 2026-07-01 explicitly uses station-adapted pricing. Italy Direct/ad-hoc is published as up to 0.91 EUR/kWh, while the subscription page exposes a lower country value/minimum and explicitly warns that station price can be higher. Therefore no single Italy-wide Direct value is deterministically applicable to all IT*IOY EVSE.
decision.rankableRule: Only rank an IOY EVSE when its applicable pre-session IONITY app/charger/direct surface price is deterministically mapped to that station/EVSE.
decision.failClosedRule: Do not promote 0.85 EUR/kWh, 0.91 EUR/kWh, or any advertised from/minimum value as a uniform network tariff. 0.91 EUR/kWh is a country maximum from 2026-07-01, not proof of each station price.
decision.directVsRoaming: IONITY Direct/ad-hoc is direct CPO pricing; eMSP roaming remains separate.

facts: app/charger displays applicable price before session
Italy structured country data exposes Direct 0.85 EUR/kWh on subscription surface
page states displayed prices are current minimum prices and station price may be higher
current Direct prices are referenced through IONITY pricing surfaces

negativePaths: Treating 0.85 EUR/kWh from country structured data as uniform Italy Direct tariff
Treating 0.91 EUR/kWh country maximum as every-station tariff
Using subscription/App prices as direct/ad-hoc prices
blockingCondition: Need deterministic IT*IOY station/EVSE -> current pre-session IONITY Direct price mapping, ideally from IONITY station page/app/charger backend.
resumeCondition: A first-party station endpoint, map payload, QR/direct surface or equivalent automatable source exposes the applicable station price.

canonicalPatchRequired.note: Canonical should absorb this classification on next safe full-file update.
